text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(y) ::: y is a novel.
WrittenBy(y, x) ::: y is written by x.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
FamilyHistory(y) ::: y is Family History.
FamilySecrets(y) ::: y is Family Secrets.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.

Premises:
¬Podcast(FamilySecrets) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornIn(x, AmericanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, then the person is American.
∀x ∀y ((Novel(y) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x)) → Writer(x)) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novelist.
American(DaniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American.
WrittenBy(FamilyHistory, DaniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(FamilyHistory) ∧ Year(FamilyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(DaniShapiro, FamilySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(Boston) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
Novel(FamilySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a novel.
